target.title: feat(browser): normalize ChatGPT Work sessions to Chat
target.body:
Closes #315.

## Motivation

ChatGPT now exposes separate `Chat` and `Work` modes. Both render a usable composer, so `ensurePromptReady` alone cannot tell whether a new Oracle browser run is about to perform ordinary Chat model/effort selection in the Work UI.

This is a standalone browser compatibility enhancement. It is independent of GPT-5.6 model aliases and picker behavior, and distinct from #308's Cloudflare classification fix.

## Design

- Probe the exact visible `Chat` / `Work` radio controls before model or effort selection.
- Switch Work to Chat through trusted CDP mouse input, verify the selected state, and re-wait for the replacement composer.
- Classify attached conversation tabs after their active history metadata hydrates.
- Extract and compare conversation IDs for both root `/c/<id>` URLs and project-scoped paths such as `/g/.../c/<id>`.
- Reset a non-resume Work attachment to a new Chat while preserving the configured project/workspace URL.
- Fail closed for an explicit resume of a Work conversation instead of silently abandoning the requested thread.
- Preserve compatibility with older layouts when Chat/Work controls and metadata are absent.
- Apply the same normalization to local and remote-Chrome browser paths.

Rebased onto current `main` at `7393c4f4`, including the merged GPT-5.6 picker, completion-control, and browser tab-cap updates.

## Validation

Exact final head: `33b01650fb1328c85bfa09703f4b34f7c2634234`.

- `pnpm vitest run tests/browser/pageActions.test.ts tests/browser/index.test.ts` — 135 passed, 1 skipped.
- `pnpm check` — passed.
- `pnpm build` — passed.
- `env -u ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL pnpm vitest run --exclude tests/browser/profileCopy.test.ts` — 1,515 passed, 44 skipped. The excluded profile-copy test requires system `rsync`.

## Exact-head project live proof

A signed-in browser profile was placed in a real Work conversation under a configured ChatGPT project URL. The exact head classified the nested project conversation by ID, returned to the same project, verified Chat, submitted, and kept the new conversation project-scoped.

```text
ChatGPT mode: Work conversation; opening a new Chat
Navigating to [redacted configured project URL]
ChatGPT mode: Chat (switched from Work)
Prompt textarea ready
Clicked send button
[browser] conversation url (post-submit) = [redacted project-scoped /c/<id> URL]
Answer:
PR316_FINAL_PROJECT_WORK_OK.
```

Completed in 13.3 seconds.

A preceding exact-head project run also exercised the additional `Work; switching to Chat` radio transition after the project reset. Earlier root-layout runs covered a Work-selected home page and a root `/c/<id>` Work attachment. No run clicked or auto-clicked ChatGPT's "Answer now" control. Profile identifiers, target IDs, project identifiers, local paths, ports, authentication data, and conversation URLs are redacted.

target.title: feat(browser): add GPT-5.6 Sol model aliases
target.body:
## Summary

- add browser-only `gpt-5.6` and `gpt-5.6-sol` aliases, both currently targeting ChatGPT's `GPT-5.6 Sol` entry
- keep the generic and pinned aliases distinct so the generic mapping can move when ChatGPT introduces a new default
- navigate through whichever GPT-5.x version submenu is currently visible, then strictly select and verify the inner Sol radio
- keep verified version evidence authoritative when the localized composer pill only shows an effort such as `极速`; missing or effort-only labels cannot self-verify as GPT-5.6 Sol
- report `switched` when a target row becomes checked after a click even if React leaves the localized effort pill unchanged
- reject bare GPT-5.6 aliases in API/multi-model paths while preserving provider-qualified custom-id passthrough
- keep unknown future variants such as `gpt-5.6-luna` from silently falling back to Sol

Fixes #305.

This complements the now-merged #304: that PR fixes the unified effort picker, while this PR adds first-class GPT-5.6 version routing and strict model-selection evidence.

Rebased onto current `main` at `7393c4f4`. Exact head: `e7e94183796950ab75ea2967736b03dd1166ecd2`.

## Tests

- `pnpm vitest run tests/browser/modelSelection.test.ts tests/cli/options.test.ts tests/cli/browserConfig.test.ts tests/runOptions.test.ts tests/cli/integrationCli.test.ts` — 250 passed
- `pnpm check` — passed
- `pnpm build` — passed
- `env -u ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL pnpm vitest run --exclude tests/browser/profileCopy.test.ts` — 1,523 passed, 44 skipped; the excluded test requires system `rsync`
- browser API fail-fast smoke exits 1 with `GPT-5.6 Sol is browser-only today`

## Live browser validation

Validated through signed-in ChatGPT Pro browser profiles:

- English (US):
  - `--model gpt-5.6` returned `ORACLE_GPT56_EN_ALIAS_OK`
  - `--model gpt-5.6-sol` returned `ORACLE_GPT56_EN_SOL_OK`
- Chinese UI, with this PR combined with the picker behavior now merged through #304:
  - `--model gpt-5.6 --browser-thinking-time extended` returned `ORACLE_GPT56_ZH_EVIDENCE_FIXED_OK`
  - model evidence reported `requested=GPT-5.6 Sol; resolved=GPT-5.6 Sol; verified=yes`
  - the effort was independently confirmed as `Thinking time: 高 (already selected)`

No live test clicked or auto-clicked ChatGPT's "Answer now" control.
